CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.users
    where auth_user_id = auth.uid()
      and role = 'admin'
      and status = 'active'
  );
$function$
